name: CPU Monitor
author: AlteringUX
description: Live CPU load on the bar with its own panel: overall + per-core usage, load average, uptime, a 10-minute trend sparkline with min/avg/max stats, and the top processes by CPU. Shares the ~/.local/bin/omarchy-sysmon sampler with memmon and tempmon.

barWidget.description: CPU % with a per-core and trend breakdown
